clusters.name: Walter's move to Sorrel Valley, 1952–1953
clusters.reason: Around Walter's move across the country in March 1952 and the purchase of the orchard, within the next year: June's homesickness and daily letters to her sister, her distance from Walter as he worked long hours, Glen's fights at school and two expulsions, June keeping to her bed for weeks that winter, Walter's cutoff from his brother Harlan over their father's land money, and Walter and June's rows over money for new trees. By September 1953, June had joined the church choir and her letters thinned out, her anxiety easing and her functioning rising; the period settles there.

clusters.name: Walter's orchard failing, 1968–1969
clusters.reason: Around the orchard's failure in May 1968 when a late frost took the crop and the bank called in the loan, within the following year: Walter drinking heavily most nights, Walter and Glen blaming each other and in conflict over the loan, Glen taking over the family's money and talks with the bank, Carl's asthma attacks worsening that winter, Nora beginning to wet the bed again at age eight, Ida having heart trouble found and told to stop working, and Walter's cutoff from Roy after the auction. By October 1969, Walter had stopped drinking and taken work pruning other men's trees, his functioning rising; the period settles there.

clusters.name: Glen's job lost at the cannery, 1975–1976
clusters.reason: Around Glen losing his job when the Ridgeport cannery closed in February 1975, within the following year: Glen out of work most of that year and sitting in the truck in the yard for hours, loud fights between Glen and Marian at night over money, Marian taking a second job cleaning offices at night, Nora stopping eating properly and losing weight that summer, Nora keeping to her room and distancing from her mother, and Walter drinking again after six years off it. By June 1976, Nora was eating again and made the track team, her functioning rising; the period settles there.

clusters.name: Wilma moving into Nora's house, 1990–1991
clusters.reason: Around Hollis's mother Wilma selling her farm and moving into Nora and Hollis's house in January 1990, within the following year: Nora clashing with Wilma over the children's bedtimes and meals, Hollis working late and keeping out of the kitchen rows, Hollis taking his mother's side, Owen having tantrums at preschool and sent home twice, Wilma taking over Lily's care, Nora's eczema flaring on both hands, and Nora and Hollis having rows most nights. By June 1991, when Wilma took a flat in town, and by August when Nora's eczema cleared over the summer, the period settles.
